text:
Aisha: FYI seeing a p99 TTFT spike for token-level SLOs on hosted eu-west-1 between ~03:10-03:40 UTC. p50 fine, p95 slight blip. Noticed tokens/sec dropped concurrently. Anyone digging?

Tom: saw it too in the dashboard. p99 went from ~220ms -> 1.2s for some routes. Marking in grafana. Could be batching fallout or cache miss storm.

grafana-bot: [alert] token_ttft_p99 (eu-west-1) fired at 2026-03-10T03:12:05Z - value=1.23s > threshold=1.0s

Lin: linking my quick PromQL checks: 
```
avg_over_time(token_ttft_seconds{region="eu-west-1"}[30m])
```
pops for specific model_version=redwood-3b-quant. Also: check prefix_cache_hit_rate and kv_cache_evictions.

Marco: ran a Loki query for serv logs around 03:10, saw a flurry of small requests hitting a fallback model variant: 
```
{job="inference"} |= "fallback-to-variant" | json | count_over_time[10m]
```
looks like ~2k more fallbacks in that window. Could explain longer TTFTs (model loading + warmup).

Priya: if fallbacks spiked, why tokens/sec drop? we'd expect more throughput. Maybe autoscaler didn't kick or some nodes insulated by region constraints?

Tom: I checked node_utilization and GPU allocation: 2 nodes in pool-2 reported CUDA driver warnings and were marked unhealthy -> they were drained, so capacity for the quant model dropped by ~18%. Autoscaler didn't spin up fast enough because max_scale is low for that pool.

Aisha: that matches: lower capacity + fallbacks = tail latency. Can we validate cache hit + KV evictions? query suggestions?

Lin: prefix hit rate promq: 
```
sum(rate(prefix_cache_hits_total[5m])) / sum(rate(prefix_cache_lookups_total[5m]))
```
kv evictions: 
```
increase(kv_cache_evictions_total[30m])
```
I see evictions spike around 03:08-03:15.

Marco: also saw a networking blip in AZ-a switch at 03:06 per infra logs. Packet drops -> timeouts -> clients retried -> small-one-shot requests -> evictions + re-loads.

Priya: cost note: if we're falling back to heavier variants and p99 TTFT stays high, customer visible degrade + token cost per request rises. Need temporary mitigation: 1) widen alert to include tokens/sec drop, 2) adjust fallback policy to prefer slower but cheaper variant? 3) increase pool max_scale.

Aisha: proposed immediate actions: 
- lift pool-2 max_scale + request burst capacity for 30m
- revert fallback aggressiveness to 2 retries before variant swap
- add Grafana drilldown panels for per-route p99 + tokens/sec heatmap
- tune alert: fire when token_ttft_p99 > 1s AND tokens_per_sec < baseline*0.7 for 5m

Tom: I can patch autoscaler config now (will open PR). Also set a temporary alert override.

Lin: I'll add the Grafana panels and a per-model p99 panel. Suggested PromQL for p99 per model: 
```
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(token_response_latency_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, model_version, route))
```
and tokens/sec heatmap: 
```
sum(rate(tokens_generated_total[5m])) by (route, instance)
```

grafana-bot: dashboard_update: "token-slo-drilldown-eu-west" panels added by Lin at 2026-03-10T04:05:12Z

Marco: patched alert rule locally to include tokens/sec and pushed to staging. test alert fired and suppressed (expected).

Priya: cost estimate for 30m extra burst capacity: ~€120 for eu-west-1 if we hit max. OK to approve?

Aisha: approve temporary burst. Please track invoice impact and we'll reconcile for next cycle.

Tom: PR #4219 opened to increase pool-2 max_scale and reduce drain sensitivity. cc @Lin for dashboards.

Lin: adding a drilldown link from p99 panel to a log query that pre-filters on 'fallback-to-variant' and 'kv_eviction' tags. Also creating an annotation range on the dashboard for 03:06-03:40.

Marco: follow-up: recommend we adjust the fallback policy long-term: prefer same-architecture variant cached in memory rather than loading cold full model. I'll add to backlog and propose during infra sync.

Aisha: thanks everyone. Action items: Tom -> deploy autoscaler PR & temp alert override, Lin -> save dashboard panels & annotate window, Marco -> RFC for fallback policy, Priya -> monitor cost and notify finance if >€200. I'll run a short postmortem doc after 24h with root cause and notes. :memo: :thumbsup:

Priya: will setup quick pager for 10m checks to ensure p99 back to baseline.

Tom: deploying now, ETA ~7m.

Lin: dashboards show p99 heading down already at 03:28 UTC. will watch.

Aisha: closing thread once p99 < 350ms for 30m and tokens/sec stable.
